[FICTIONAL SAMPLE — not a real lease]
Anonymised test fixture with the structure of a real NYC lease. Names and amounts are invented.

APARTMENT LEASE

Landlord: Sample Gardens LLC
c/o Sample Management, 40 Harbor Road, Great Neck, NY 11021
Tenant: Alex Example

1. APARTMENT AND TERM. Landlord rents to Tenant and Tenant rents from Landlord the apartment at
155 157 East 92nd Street, 4N, New York, NY 10128 for a term of one year (12 months), beginning
on September 1, 2026 and ending on August 31, 2027, at a monthly rent of $3,000.00.

2. RENT. Tenant shall pay the monthly rent of $3,000.00 in advance on the first day of each month.

3. SECURITY. Tenant has given Landlord a security deposit of $6,000.00, which Landlord will hold
in a New York bank and return within fourteen (14) days after the lease ends.

4. LATE CHARGE. If rent is not paid within five (5) days after it is due, Tenant shall pay a
reasonable late charge of the lesser of fifty (50) dollars or five percent (5%) of the monthly rent.

5. NOTICES. All notices to Landlord shall be sent to Sample Gardens LLC, 40 Harbor Road,
Great Neck, NY 11021.

THERE IS NO MAINTAINED AND OPERATIVE SPRINKLER SYSTEM IN THE LEASED PREMISES.
